title: Dissipative non-Abelian fluids from Scherk-Schwarz dimensional reduction
summary: We construct a $d$-dimensional dissipative colored fluid by Scherk--Schwarz reduction of a neutral viscous conformal fluid in $D=d+n$ dimensions on an $n$-dimensional unimodular group manifold. The off-diagonal components of the higher-dimensional stress tensor become non-Abelian color currents, while the higher-dimensional shear tensor induces shear, bulk-like and vector-dissipative structures in the reduced theory.
